title: Family

regenerateWarning: The previous code stops working as soon as you generate a new one.
joinHelp: Enter an Invite Code from the Owner of the Family you want to join.
joinWarning: Your current Household of One and its Pantry and Shopping data will be deleted. Data is not merged.

deleteConfirm: Delete this Family and all its data? Every Member, you included, will get a new, empty Household of One. This cannot be undone.
